# Real metric samples captured from a LIVE Stakater Cloud cluster (us-2, 2026-07-20),
# Crossplane core v2.1.3 + Stakater upjet AWS providers v2.3.0 (provider-aws-s3 etc.).
#
# These are the metrics the pinned kind rig in tests/integration.sh CANNOT emit — they only
# register once composition Functions run (function_run_*), the realtime circuit breaker
# engages (circuit_breaker_*), or an Upjet provider reconciles resources (upjet_resource_*).
# Captured here (a real cluster that exercises those paths), so the referenced metrics are
# proven present WITH the labels the rules key on, and stay in metrics-allowlist.captured.txt.
# integration.sh feeds this file to capture-metrics.sh via --extra (same pattern as
# inventory-metrics.txt); the weekly kind capture does not overwrite it.
#
# Label contracts the rules depend on (verified in these samples):
#   function_run_function_response_total  -> function_name + result_severity (Normal|Fatal)
#   circuit_breaker_events_total          -> controller + result (Allowed|Dropped|HalfOpenAllowed)
#   upjet_resource_*_bucket               -> group/kind/version (+ le); NO `gvk` label

# --- Crossplane core: composition functions (Stories 5.1, 5.2) ---
# HELP function_run_function_response_total Total number of RunFunctionResponses received.
# TYPE function_run_function_response_total counter

# --- Provider runtime: managed-resource drift (Story 3.1) ---
# Captured from us-2 provider-kubernetes (2026-07-28). This is a HISTOGRAM, not the
# per-GVK gauge the chart originally assumed — only _bucket/_sum/_count exist, so the
# bare `crossplane_managed_resource_drift_seconds` name never matched anything and
# DriftDetected could not fire. Kept here because the pinned kind rig never drifts a
# resource, so its capture cannot register this family.
#
# NOTE the bucket boundaries: they stop at le=10 while real observations are minutes
# (mean here = 8858877/113901 = 77.8s), so ~all mass lands in +Inf and quantiles are
# meaningless on this metric. The rule and the dashboard panel both use the mean,
# rate(_sum)/rate(_count). Label contract: gvk only (no group/kind/version).
# HELP crossplane_managed_resource_drift_seconds ALPHA: How long since the previous successful reconcile when a resource was found to be out of sync; excludes restart of the provider
# TYPE crossplane_managed_resource_drift_seconds histogram
crossplane_managed_resource_drift_seconds_bucket{gvk="kubernetes.crossplane.io/v1alpha2, Kind=Object",le="1e-08"} 0
crossplane_managed_resource_drift_seconds_bucket{gvk="kubernetes.crossplane.io/v1alpha2, Kind=Object",le="1e-07"} 0
crossplane_managed_resource_drift_seconds_bucket{gvk="kubernetes.crossplane.io/v1alpha2, Kind=Object",le="1e-06"} 0
crossplane_managed_resource_drift_seconds_bucket{gvk="kubernetes.crossplane.io/v1alpha2, Kind=Object",le="9.999999999999999e-06"} 0
crossplane_managed_resource_drift_seconds_bucket{gvk="kubernetes.crossplane.io/v1alpha2, Kind=Object",le="9.999999999999999e-05"} 0
crossplane_managed_resource_drift_seconds_bucket{gvk="kubernetes.crossplane.io/v1alpha2, Kind=Object",le="0.001"} 0
crossplane_managed_resource_drift_seconds_bucket{gvk="kubernetes.crossplane.io/v1alpha2, Kind=Object",le="0.01"} 0
